title: KS4 summary
description: One row per school of the supplier's KS4 school summary file, transcribed from the LDS Data Spec tab 'KS4 Summary Data report'. The fields are the state schools report, in its order; the reports for independent schools, FE colleges and non-maintained special schools are subsets, and each field's description names the reports it is in. The EBacc indicators marked removed (2026) are left out. Field references (indicator names) are the CSV headers; the 'Summary Report CE website description' is the heading of the CSV a school downloads and the label schools see. Values are strings, because a suppressed value is sent as 'NA' or '+'.
